issue_title: Public sponsor-booth YouTube embeds are blocked by CSP
problem_statement:
Public sponsor-booth YouTube embeds are blocked by CSP

## Problem

Independent exact-head review of #1903 found a pre-existing CSP mismatch outside that PR: `src/lib/public-sponsor-booth.ts` emits `https://www.youtube.com/embed/...`, but generated `frame-src` does not allow `https://www.youtube.com`. Browsers therefore block those sponsor-booth embeds.

## Safe direction

Prefer normalizing this helper to the already allowlisted privacy-enhanced `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com` origin rather than widening CSP to another YouTube host. Add a source-to-generated-policy contract test and a removal/widening mutant.

## Boundaries

Do not change tenant content, upload media, widen CSP with wildcards, deploy/promote, seed/import, alter schema/secrets, or make pricing/legal decisions. Not part of milestone 1.1 unless explicitly triaged there.
